Overview

Surabaya is a city in East Java with a population of 2,874,000. Indonesia’s second-largest city and East Java’s bustling port metropolis with a growing economy. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
